_readme: Every real ChatCut recording/result is a SLOT. status 'placeholder' renders skeletons + a PLACEHOLDER ribbon. Real media: put the file in assets/, set file + source, status 'verified', run `python3 build.py`, and add the <video> element described in REPLACE.md. Never mark verified without the real recording on disk.

hook_ba.note: Real BEFORE and AFTER clips of the same footage (before-and-after hook).

editor_rec.note: Real ChatCut editor recording: a cut, captions appearing, B-roll added.

install_status.note: Real `claude plugin details chatcut@chatcut-inc` / `claude mcp get plugin:chatcut:chatcut` (Connected). Hide any account info.

demo_log.note: Real Claude Code session: the exact prompt, tool actions, timeline edits.

demo_result.note: Real edited timeline + preview vs the original. Show export only if it really succeeded.
